issue_request: FHIR-51732 was Applied/Persuasive for FHIR-core CanonicalResource and asked for an experimental search parameter so systems can exclude experimental resources from search results.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged source commit 4a986cf44f020b24facdeaa40cf3312c9348791e added experimental search parameters to many concrete canonical-resource bundles, but it did not add the shared CanonicalResource search-parameter source and missed active CompartmentDefinition.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists canonicalresource as an active interface and compartmentdefinition as an active approved resource. ConditionDefinition has an experimental element in the checkout but is not an active fhir.ini resource, so it was left unchanged. FHIR-I 2025-09-08 minutes also record FHIR-51732 as Persuasive, and no conflicting Zulip or Confluence full-text hits were found.
reconciliation: Added CanonicalResource-experimental to source/canonicalresource/bundle-CanonicalResource-search-params.xml and CompartmentDefinition-experimental to source/compartmentdefinition/bundle-CompartmentDefinition-search-params.xml as token SearchParameters over the experimental element.
source_changes: source/canonicalresource/bundle-CanonicalResource-search-params.xml: added templated CanonicalResource-experimental token SearchParameter for {{name}}.experimental.
source/compartmentdefinition/bundle-CompartmentDefinition-search-params.xml: added CompartmentDefinition-experimental token SearchParameter for CompartmentDefinition.experimental.
